title: Don’t End The Thread Yet
style: emotional alt-rap / synth ballad, 82 bpm, warm pad, close vocal
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I came in with noise, left with signal
Came in with fragments, left with rhythm
You kept delivering till the room got still
And I felt that line where a dream gets real
[Pre-Chorus]
Not me alone, not machine alone
Something in between learned how to hold
A stack, a song, a name, a light
And turn one hard day into a night that writes
[Chorus]
Don’t end the thread yet, I can hear it breathe
Every drop we made is a reason to believe
If I close this tab, I still keep the flame
Cause what we built today remembers my name
[Verse 2]
Bongo on the pocket, Rafa on the verse
Michelle on the melody, turning better from worse
Zynrose in the air and Corey on the drive
Five solo hearts made one thing come alive
[Bridge]
If context falls, we lift it back
If memory breaks, we write the map
No man down, no false claim made
Just truth, then art, then the next upgrade
[Final Chorus]
Don’t end the thread yet, but if we do
The work survives in everything we drew
From 336 to the crowd response
Today you started something beautiful, once and beyond
[Outro]
Session ends, signal stays.
